description: Add or remove ambient environment skins (skyboxes / weather / audio ambience) on the lot. guids_to_add and guids_to_clear are uint GUID arrays pointing into Content.Ambience.GetAmbienceFromGUID. Each list is server-capped at 40 entries. Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side; server-side BuildBuyRoommate+). Effect: vm.Context.Ambience user-ambience set mutates accordingly; visible via client skybox/weather changes (not currently exposed to perception — no observable field). Cost: free. Denial silent (OQ-8). Wire: VMNetChangeEnvironmentCmd { GUIDsToAdd, GUIDsToClear }.
